antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 810nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in pneumocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Gentle regeneration: 345 THz (870nm) at low power, continuous, targets neuron mitochondria targeting cytochrome_c_oxidase in pneumocyte. Study reference: 2025 peer-reviewed paper shows ATP +28% at 810nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial complex_II_SDH activation.
